terminals.name: gopro-backend
terminals.command: cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace GOPRO_LITE_MODE=1 GOPRO_CLEANER_HOST=127.0.0.1 GOPRO_CLEANER_PORT=8765 /workspace/.venv/bin/python -m gopro_cleaner

terminals.name: gopro-frontend
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="${HOME}/.nvm"; [ -s "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh" ] && . "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh"; cd /workspace/gopro_cleaner/frontend && npm run dev

terminals.name: sd-offloader
terminals.command: cd /workspace/sd_offloader && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/sd_offloader SD_OFFLOADER_HOST=127.0.0.1 SD_OFFLOADER_PORT=8877 SD_OFFLOADER_OPEN_BROWSER=0 /workspace/.venv/bin/python -m offloader
